mapper.select: /* QnA 목록 조회 */ SELECT i.inquiry_id , i.question_type_id , c.code_item_name AS category_name , i.title , i.answer_status , i.user_id , i.created_at FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN code_item c ON i.question_type_id = c.code_item_id WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC

/* QnA 상세 조회 (카테고리명, 답변 포함) */ SELECT i.inquiry_id AS qnaId , i.question_type_id AS qnaCategoryId , c.code_item_name AS categoryName , i.title AS title , i.question_content AS content , i.answer_status AS status , i.visible_yn AS isVisible , i.created_at AS createdAt , i.user_id AS userId , ia.answer_content AS answerContent , ia.created_at AS answerCreatedAt FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN code_item c ON i.question_type_id = c.code_item_id LEFT JOIN inquiry_answer ia ON i.inquiry_id = ia.inquiry_id WHERE i.inquiry_id = #{qnaId}
